atomic_facts.fact: Greg Abel's official position title at Berkshire Hathaway is Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
Greg Abel held the CEO position at Berkshire Hathaway as of 2026-10-01 (he became CEO on January 1, 2026, and is referred to as Berkshire Hathaway CEO in sources dated September 2026).
Greg Abel served as Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway Energy Company (BHE).
BHE is a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway (approximately 90.9%-91% owned).
Greg Abel's tenure as BHE CEO began in 2008 and ran until January 9, 2018.
2008 was the year Greg Abel first joined Berkshire Hathaway.
